Noctis PM Affiliate Program

📌 Brand Introduction

Noctis PM is a high-quality, functional, and stylish sportswear brand for both men and women. Designed for athletes and fitness enthusiasts, our collections combine performance, comfort, and fashion—helping people feel confident while pushing their limits. Inspired by the needs of real athletes, our gear delivers exceptional durability, flexibility, and style for both training and everyday wear.

🛍 Product Description

We offer a premium selection of sportswear, including:
✔ Performance leggings & shorts – Squat-proof, moisture-wicking, and designed for intense workouts
✔ Sports bras & tops – Stylish, breathable, and supportive for all activities
✔ Men’s activewear – Functional and stylish pieces that transition seamlessly from training to lifestyle
✔ Limited Edition Drops – Unique collections inspired by cities, culture, and performance needs

Noctis PM isn’t just clothing—it’s gear that moves with you.

💡 Unique Selling Points (USP)

  • Designed for Athletes – Built for movement, durability, and high performance
  • Premium Materials – Sweat-wicking, squat-proof, and breathable fabric
  • Stylish & Functional – Wearable from the gym to the streets
  • Limited Edition Collections – Exclusive designs you won’t find anywhere else
  • Community-Driven – We collaborate with athletes, trainers, and fitness enthusiasts to create the best gear

💰 Payment Terms

  • Commission Rate: Earn 10% per sale (based on performance & tiers)
  • Payout Method: PayPal, Venmo, 
  • Payout Schedule: Monthly (every 1st of the month)
  • Tracking System: Unique affiliate links & discount codes

📢 Other Information

🔹 Who Can Join? – Athletes, trainers, fitness influencers, content creators, and passionate customers
🔹 Exclusive Perks – Top affiliates get early access to new collections, free products, and bonus rewards
🔹 Marketing Support – We provide high-quality images, captions, and content ideas to help you promote
🔹 Easy-to-Use Dashboard – Track your clicks, sales, and earnings in real time
